description: This file defines the Java entity class 'DrugIngredient' which models the relationship between drugs and their ingredients within the OpenMRS system. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, getter/setter methods for properties like drug, ingredient, strength, and units, and is part of the core OpenMRS data model for managing medication ingredients.

classes.name: DrugIngredient
classes.description: Entity class representing the link between a Drug and its ingredient (Concept), along with properties like strength and units.

methods.name: getDrug
methods.description: Returns the Drug object associated with this ingredient link.

methods.name: setDrug
methods.description: Sets the Drug object for this ingredient link.

methods.name: getIngredient
methods.description: Returns the Concept object representing the ingredient.

methods.name: setIngredient
methods.description: Sets the Concept object for the ingredient.

methods.name: getStrength
methods.description: Returns the strength value of the ingredient in the drug.

methods.name: setStrength
methods.description: Sets the strength value of the ingredient.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the Concept object representing the units of measurement.

methods.name: setUnits
methods.description: Sets the units of measurement for the ingredient.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier; currently unsupported and throws exception.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier; currently unsupported and throws exception.
